verdict.rationale: Groq's core inference workflows are documented as API-first: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, the Responses API, batch jobs, service tiers, tool use, remote MCP and audio transcription, all with official SDKs. Nothing shows that console-side functions such as spend limits, budget alerts, billing or LoRA adapter upload can be done through the API. No public OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404). Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for console account, billing and spend-limit management, API key management, programmatic LoRA upload, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of UI/API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: This library provides convenient access to the Groq REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
Batch processing lets you run thousands of API requests at scale by submitting your workload as an asynchronous batch of requests to Groq
You can distinguish these by providing the service_tier parameter.
